ke-0UwZ.title: Climate: humid, semi-arid, arid, very arid
ke-0UwZ.summary: Different regions have distinct climates: humid, semi-arid, arid and very arid, with transitional climates between. Use the dryness to guess the general area.

ke-1AUr.title: Landscape: flat road, sugar cane
ke-1AUr.summary: A flat east-west road with two long straight sections of sugar cane, and a large mountain range to the north throughout.

ke-1b3E.title: Fences: endless stick fences
ke-1b3E.summary: Stick fences that seem to go on forever are common in one area of the southwest.

ke-2BIS.title: Plants: coconut palms
ke-2BIS.summary: Coconut palms point to the coast, and rarely to one inland county.

ke-3h2M.title: Google car: grey SUV following behind
ke-3h2M.summary: In a lot of the coverage a grey Toyota SUV follows the Street View car.

ke-7mU2.title: Vans: repurposed vans with wrapped designs
ke-7mU2.summary: Repurposed vans with colourful wraps are everywhere. Uganda has them too, but the wrap design is clearly different.

differs.how: The wrap design on the vans is clearly different

ke-A27G.title: Houses: mud and sticks
ke-A27G.summary: Houses made of mud and sticks are common in the west and on the coast.

ke-Af01.title: Sign: green direction sign, white border
ke-Af01.summary: Green direction signs with a white border and text. Road numbers show in white or yellow.

ke-B91r.title: Google car: grey, small snorkel, flat tan grass
ke-B91r.summary: A grey car with a small snorkel in a very flat area with tan grass, few trees and dried lake beds. The base of a huge mountain is always visible to the south, mostly in cloud.

ke-BMtm.title: Pole: skull and danger warning marking
ke-BMtm.summary: Poles often carry a marking with a skull and a danger message.

ke-CxYS.title: Landscape: plants by the road, big mountains
ke-CxYS.summary: A road with many plants beside it and large mountains in the distance. One stretch has a very large mountain range to the west.

ke-ElFx.title: Road: unpaved, bright reddish-orange dirt
ke-ElFx.summary: An entirely unpaved road with bright reddish-orange dirt and many trees. Mostly flat, with hills at the western end, where the soil turns sandier.

ke-Gu08.title: Google car: grey-brown car in sandy, dry land
ke-Gu08.summary: The same car as the grey-and-brown park car but in very sandy, dry land with little vegetation. You may also meet Gen 3 coverage without any car.

ke-HNI4.title: Google car: grey and brown, big snorkel
ke-HNI4.summary: A grey and brown car with a large snorkel. Almost all coverage is outside the park; the main road inside has rubber bands on the roof rack, found in only one other park.

ke-LuwZ.title: Sign: county name written on signs and posters
ke-LuwZ.summary: Signs, billboards and posters often show the county name, which helps a lot with narrowing down the region.

ke-MyUL.title: Plate: long white front, square yellow rear
ke-MyUL.summary: Front plates are long and white, while rear plates are square and yellow.

ke-Nnps.title: Sign: PO BOX with post code number
ke-Nnps.summary: Signs read like PO BOX XXX-YYYZZ. The number YYY is a post code that narrows down the area, and often the city name follows. A PO BOX with no second number is not helpful.

ke-QUCR.title: Road: blinding white dirt
ke-QUCR.summary: Blinding white dirt roads combined with extremely red soil beside the road.

ke-Rz26.title: Walls: light bricks with thick mortar
ke-Rz26.summary: Light-coloured bricks with a lot of mortar between them, in walls along the coast.

ke-TVBv.title: View: huge mountain to the south
ke-TVBv.summary: In lots of coverage in the south, a huge mountain sits to the south, usually hidden by cloud. In one town it is often directly south.

ke-UIHO.title: City: skyscrapers, dense
ke-UIHO.summary: The capital is the only city with many skyscrapers. It is very developed and dense, surrounded by small, poor settlements.

ke-VMnN.title: Landscape: much flatter, few plants
ke-VMnN.summary: North of a mountain town the land is much flatter with less vegetation. Mountains are visible in the distance, to the south at first and a different range further north.

ke-WAmc.title: Phone network: one brand in every city
ke-WAmc.summary: A mobile network brand, Safaricom, is unique to this country, and almost every city has a shop for it.

ke-Zc6E.title: Landscape: light soil, many green trees
ke-Zc6E.summary: A road with light-coloured soil and many green trees on both sides.

ke-aCQP.title: Sign: red and white road signs
ke-aCQP.summary: Road signs are not frequent, but the ones you see are mostly red and white.

ke-aD58.title: Landscape: flat or hilly, no mountains
ke-aD58.summary: A reserve with no big mountains, mostly flat or hilly. It has a white car that also appears in other national parks, and Gen 4 coverage exists there too.

ke-akOH.title: Landscape: flat east and north
ke-akOH.summary: The east and large parts of the north are extremely flat. The further southwest you go, the higher the land gets.

ke-beMe.title: Road lines: solid white outer, yellow inner
ke-beMe.summary: Outer lines are always solid white, while inner lines are yellow, either solid or dashed.

ke-dndL.title: Pole: concrete or wood, L-shaped crossbar
ke-dndL.summary: Concrete or wooden poles with an L-shaped crossbar. Ghana has a similar pole.

ke-dsJg.title: Google car: grey-brown car with rubber bands
ke-dsJg.summary: The same car as the grey-and-brown park car, but always with rubber bands. Redder dirt and a greener landscape tell it apart from the park.

ke-fUkM.title: Landscape: farms, grassy hills, tall eucalyptus
ke-fUkM.summary: In the far west, the most agricultural area: farms, grassy hills and tall eucalyptus trees.

ke-j1yc.title: Landscape: tan soil, sparse low trees
ke-j1yc.summary: In the northwest, with very limited coverage: faintly tan soil and sparse low trees, mostly flat but sometimes with hills. The car is usually dirty and exposed.

ke-keVS.title: Houses: red brick
ke-keVS.summary: Red brick buildings are common in the west and in a large area east of the capital.

ke-lm-13112.title: Google car: white tape on roof
ke-lm-13112.summary: Pieces of white tape are visible on the car's roof in a lot of the coverage around the capital.

ke-lm-13114.title: Landscape: white sand, palms, coastal feel
ke-lm-13114.summary: Coastal towns are easy to spot by white sandy soil, palm trees and a seaside feel.

ke-lm-13117.title: Google car: cord on left, light orange dirt
ke-lm-13117.summary: A road with light orange dirt and many hills nearby and in the distance. Most of this coverage has a car with a cord on the left.

ke-lm-13118.title: Google car: covered in specks of dirt
ke-lm-13118.summary: A car covered in specks of dirt, unique to a few roads in the north and east.

ke-lm-3651.title: Google car: two bird droppings
ke-lm-3651.summary: On one tiny bit of coverage inside a national park, the car has two clear splats of bird poop.

ke-lm-489984.title: Pole: wooden with metal top bar and support
ke-lm-489984.summary: Wooden poles with a metal top bar and support. Panama mostly has concrete poles with a wooden support, handy for a 50/50.

differs.how: Panamanian poles are mostly concrete with wooden support

ke-m7bX.title: Landscape: protruding hill to the east
ke-m7bX.summary: A lakeside town with a protruding hill to the east that is often visible.

ke-mwv5.title: Google car: Gen 4 pickup, often a snorkel
ke-mwv5.summary: Mostly a Gen 4 pickup truck. It is usually blurred, but you may see parts of it in many colours, or a raised antenna pipe (snorkel). Only Mongolia also has a snorkel in Gen 4.

ke-nQVJ.title: Plants: lots of white flowers
ke-nQVJ.summary: Large numbers of white flowers are common in parts of the south, near a national park and south of the capital.

ke-pGmv.title: Plants: eucalyptus with long leaves
ke-pGmv.summary: Many kinds of eucalyptus, with long, often clumped leaves and smooth bark. They grow in other countries too, so use this only to back up a guess.

ke-pP7Q.title: Google car: Gen 3 roof rack and snorkel
ke-pP7Q.summary: Gen 3 coverage often shows a roof rack and a raised antenna pipe (snorkel). Some Gen 3 coverage shows no car at all.

ke-pf4x.title: Google car: unusual cars near national parks
ke-pf4x.summary: Many unusual cars around national parks and reserves, almost all with a snorkel (a raised antenna pipe). You need the landscape too, as many cars appear in several places.

ke-t60C.title: Landscape: semi-arid, mountainous
ke-t60C.summary: Semi-arid, usually mountainous land with light orange, sandy dirt.

ke-us0A.title: Roadside: many succulents
ke-us0A.summary: A stretch of road with many succulents along the side.

ke-wDuQ.title: Coverage: mainly main roads outside southwest
ke-wDuQ.summary: Outside the southwest, coverage is mostly just main roads.
